dataset_name: Google datacenter trace-derived cloud-edge simulation input
selection_method: First requested submit events (event_type=0) in supplied partition order, at/after documented observation start; stable timestamp ordering

sources.checksum_scope: Bytes consumed from source; partial when complete_source_read is false

mapping.arrival_time_s: (observed timestamp_us - first retained timestamp_us) / 1e6; no jitter or invented spacing
mapping.memory_demand_mb: 64 + 4096*memory_request; assumed conversion and metadata, not an enforced RAM admission limit
mapping.priority: Original priority clipped to [0,100], bucketed using cutpoints [-1,1,4,8,100] into [1,2,3,4]
mapping.task_type: Descriptive analyst labels inferred from scheduling_class; not measured application identity
mapping.source_zone_and_edge_candidate: job_id modulo 4; synthetic labels, not measured location or mobility
mapping.edge_cloud_network_delay_ms: 45 + 25*clip(task_size_kb / p95(task_size_kb),0,1); modeled delay, not measured network performance
mapping.lambda_at_arrival_tps: Empirical task count in each one-second bin; not a measured instantaneous Poisson intensity
mapping.burst_flag: Constant zero placeholder; actual timestamp ties and gaps are retained independently
mapping.missing_resource_priority_or_class_value: Non-numeric/nonfinite values imputed as zero; negative CPU/memory rows excluded
mapping.disk_request: Negative values clipped to zero by the mapping
mapping.capacity_network_energy_cost: Chosen simulation assumptions; not inferred from the Google trace

sampling_limitations: One selected prefix is not a representative sample of all deployment conditions
Repeated evaluation of this same input does not create independent trace samples
Last timestamp group may be partially retained at the requested record count
mapping_note: Only submission timing and source resource requests/identifiers are observed. Task computation, transfers, deadlines, placement, edge/cloud capacities, cost and energy are modeled assumptions. This is not validation on a contemporary edge deployment.
